---
title: "Conheça a Equipe"
# Cada listagem filtra as páginas .pt.qmd dos membros por people_group,
# em ordem alfabética de nome. Grupos sem integrantes no momento (pós-doc,
# doutorado) ficam comentados aqui e nas seções abaixo, prontos para ativar.
listing:
  - id: professor
    contents:
      - "*/*.pt.qmd"
    include:
      people_group: "professor"
    template: ../_ejs/people-card.ejs
    sort: title
    type: grid
    fields: [title, subtitle, image, education]
  # - id: postdoc
  #   contents:

  #   sort: title
  #   type: grid
  #   fields: [title, subtitle, image, education]
  - id: phd
    contents:
      - "*/*.pt.qmd"
    include:
      people_group: "phd"
    template: ../_ejs/people-card.ejs
    sort: title
    type: grid
    fields: [title, subtitle, image, education]
  - id: masters
    contents:
      - "*/*.pt.qmd"
    include:
      people_group: "masters"
    template: ../_ejs/people-card.ejs
    sort: title
    type: grid
    fields: [title, subtitle, image, education]
  - id: undergrad
    contents:
      - "*/*.pt.qmd"
    include:
      people_group: "undergrad"
    template: ../_ejs/people-card.ejs
    sort: title
    type: grid
    fields: [title, subtitle, image, education]
  - id: alumni
    contents:
      - "*/*.pt.qmd"
    include:
      people_group: "alumni"
    template: ../_ejs/people-card.ejs
    sort: title
    type: grid
    fields: [title, subtitle, image, education]
page-layout: full
toc: false
